description: Controlled-motion baseline (PR-VID-MOTION-410). Unexecuted template: bind your own images and driving videos, and a physical run needs the owner's separate authorization. Full 49-frame group: head turn, right-hand wave and raise both arms, two subjects each, three arms (18 jobs).

cases.prompt: a person standing in a plain, evenly lit studio, head and shoulders, seen from the front, photorealistic

motion.action: Turns the head from facing the camera to the subject's right, about 60 degrees, and holds.
motion.motion_prompt: the person slowly turns their head to their right and holds, body and shoulders still
motion.expected_outcome: The intended subject's head rotates smoothly about 60 degrees toward their right and holds there; the shoulders and background stay still and the face is not replaced or duplicated.

cases.prompt: a person standing in a plain, evenly lit studio, upper body, seen from the front, photorealistic

motion.action: Raises the right hand to shoulder height and waves side to side about three times.
motion.motion_prompt: the person raises their right hand and waves it side to side three times
motion.expected_outcome: The intended subject's right hand rises to shoulder height or above and waves with at least two visible side-to-side swings; the other arm stays down and no second hand or arm appears.

motion.expected_outcome: Both arms of the intended subject rise together from the sides to above head height, with the hands finishing overhead; the body stays in place and no extra arms appear.
